name: sketch-notes
description: /sketch: a full-screen board for your running local apps, window screenshots and images. Click anything to say what should change: a note on a live page names its component, source file and line. Attach it all to your prompt, and a skill tells Claude how to read it.

opens.title: Where /sketch opens
opens.description: window: a full-screen canvas in a browser app window (a Chrome-family browser when installed, else your default browser). pane: the canvas inside the terminal. /sketch pane or /sketch window picks one for a single run.

folder.title: Where sketches are saved
folder.description: The folder attached sketches (and the board) are kept in: ~/.claude/sketches by default, outside every project so they are never committed. Relative paths are taken from the folder Claude Code runs in.
